title: The Walten Files 5 - Faces of Grief
original_title: The Walten Files 5 - Faces of Grief
overview: Rosemary Peony Walten has lost two of her children in a horrific accident involving his husband's business associate, leaving her struck with grief in a house emptier than it has ever been. As the line between her art, involving the animatronic characters of her family's restaurant franchise, and reality slowly blends together, Rosemary will eventually have to face that not all ghosts are apparitions of her mind.
